item.title: IDF strikes Hamas commandos during drill as terror group tries to rebuild in Gaza
item.description: Military says overnight drone strike in central Gaza killed at least 4 Nukhba operatives during training session, as group seeks to reconstitute its elite force that led the Oct. 7 attacks

item.title: Hamas operative approached Gaza buffer zone with toddler son as human shield, IDF says
item.description: Military says detained Hamas operative admitted using his son as human shield near Gaza’s yellow line; relatives claim toddler separated for hours and abused; IDF says both father, son lightly hurt from shrapnel, child treated and later handed to Red Cross

item.title: Israel says airstrikes trap Iranian missiles underground, disrupt launch network
